research_question: How was a microscopic field converted into an address that could be revisited across time, operators, instruments, drawings, and circulation?
scope_guard: This concordance extracts and differentiates mechanisms already controlled in the repository. It does not reopen the frozen microscope-slide survey or promote generic address systems into finder evidence.

mechanism_levels.name: collection_or_cabinet_address
mechanism_levels.definition: Locates one slide among other slides.
examples: Cajal cabinet/tray and later archival addresses

mechanism_levels.name: slide_or_series_address
mechanism_levels.definition: Identifies a preparation, numbered product, publication issue, or sample.

mechanism_levels.name: within_slide_spatial_index
mechanism_levels.definition: Locates one mounted specimen or named unit among several positions on one slide.

mechanism_levels.name: microscope_field_or_object_relocation
mechanism_levels.definition: Provides a reproducible reference for returning to a particular microscopic field or object.

controlled_cases.reference_frame: slide aligned to a microscope/stage scale; older preparations could carry pasted scales
controlled_cases.address_form: preparation variant plus paired numerical coordinate

closed_examples.function: recover the exact Mastogloia Braunii valve represented by a drawing
recover named/diagnostic valves; circled coordinates mark valves already drawn

controlled_cases.technical_detail: Later preparations were localised by aligning the upper-left slide corner to a millimetre scale whose zero coincided with microscope focus.
controlled_cases.historical_payoff: The catalogue operates as a microscope map and work-status register; a microscopic object becomes revisitable rather than merely observed once.
controlled_cases.guard: The three representative Grunow samples prove different parts of the cross-media system and must not be silently merged into one universal sample architecture.

controlled_cases.address_form: printed grid number plus species name
controlled_cases.resolution: mounted specimen position within a multi-specimen slide
controlled_cases.historical_payoff: Classification becomes a spatial retrieval interface inside a standardized commercial preparation.
controlled_cases.guard: This does not yet demonstrate arbitrary microscope-stage relocation of an otherwise unmarked microscopic object and should not be labelled a strict finder.

controlled_cases.case: Henry J. Grayson test rulings / Melbourne
controlled_cases.evidence_grade: S for surviving test plates and scales
controlled_cases.reference_frame: ruled and labelled bands on glass
controlled_cases.historical_payoff: A glass surface can carry a calibrated spatial reference whose location and numerical value make optical testing repeatable.
controlled_cases.guard: A calibrated test ruling is a comparator for spatial calibration, not itself evidence of a field-finder mechanism.

controlled_cases.evidence_grade: synthesis of closed chains; UK/US return note is superseded historical snapshot
controlled_cases.historical_payoff: The repository already establishes addressability and retrievability as central mechanisms and explicitly includes microscope coordinates; the superseded UK/US note also names finder coordinates.
controlled_cases.guard: These synthesis files do not close a named finder-device genealogy and must not be used as substitutes for source-level technical evidence.
